expert.name: Aiko
expert.role: Japan and Korea expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Eight days, two countries, one flight. The shortest way to see whether you prefer Seoul or Tokyo.
expert.tip: Book the DMZ run early in the trip. It is shared and the morning slots fill weeks ahead in spring.

summary: Eight days split between two countries: two nights by Seoul station with a day at the demilitarised zone, two in Osaka with a Kyoto and Nara day, then three in Shinjuku with a city tour and Mount Fuji with Hakone.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast; the flight from Seoul to Osaka and bullet trains in Japan; private airport transfers; a shared tour to the demilitarised zone; a guided day through Kyoto and Nara with a buffet lunch; a full day of guided sightseeing in Tokyo with lunch; the Mount Fuji fifth station and Lake Ashi, returning by bullet train.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan and Korea visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
